title.narrative: Inclusive Development Endeavour for Advancement of persons with disability (IDEA)

description.narrative:
This project aims to mobilize people with disabilities living in hard to reach areas in south-west Bangladesh and organize them into self-help groups and disabled people's organisations (DPOs) as well as building capacity of persons with disabilities in the wider area.
ADD Bangladesh’s ultimate goal is to create a grassroots movement of persons with disabilities throughout Bangladesh contributing to a vibrant disability rights movement. ADD mobilizes people with disabilities (PWDs) at the grassroots level by providing awareness, skills and leadership development training, and encouraging them to come together as self-help groups (SHGs) at the community level and DPOs at the union level.
The project will be implemented over 2 years (April 2015 - March 2017). The project will form DPOs and SHGs in remote locations where PWDs are often extremely marginalised and excluded from development initiatives. The groups will provide platforms for PWD to negotiate access to services (health/sanitation, inclusion in social safety nets etc.) and mobilise resources for creating livelihood and income opportunities. The project will also provide training and livelihood support to PWDs (at least 50% women) as well as linking them to public and private sector market actors. Advocacy and policy influencing activities will also target at a local and national level.
Additionally, this project will aim to strengthen ADD's organisational capacity including updating and training staff on relevant policies (HR and Gender), improving monitoring and evaluation (M&E) skills among a key staff and developing high quality communications documents.
